children: Weekly SUSHI purchases into the Sushi Strategic Reserve begin, following approval of the strategic reserve and a revised buyback program through two separate voting rounds. The program converts the governance outcome into a recurring purchase schedule, with SUSHI acquired on a weekly basis and added to the reserve rather than distributed or burned.

The purchases create a recurring structural buy bid for SUSHI, since a fixed weekly acquisition now runs independently of market conditions. For holders, this is a confirmed, governance-backed demand program rather than a discretionary buyback that can be paused without a new vote.

The scale of each weekly purchase has not been stated, so the program's market effect depends on details released later. The two-round approval process does establish that the reserve and its funding mechanism carry an explicit mandate.
The Sushi Strategic Reserve + Revised Buyback Program has passed both rounds of voting.
- Weekly SUSHI purchases into the Reserve start Monday, September 7th.

title: Sushi: Weekly Strategic Reserve SUSHI purchases begin after governance approval - 07 Sep 2026
